description: This file defines the DestinationCalendarRepository class, which provides methods for interacting with destination calendar data in a database, including CRUD operations, conflict checking, and upsert functionality.

classes.name: DestinationCalendarRepository
classes.description: Repository class for managing destination calendar data, including creation, retrieval, updating, conflict detection, and upsert operations.

methods.name: getCustomReminderByCredentialId
methods.description: Retrieves the custom calendar reminder for a given credential ID.

methods.name: updateCustomReminder
methods.description: Updates the custom calendar reminder for a specific user, credential, and integration.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new destination calendar record with provided data.

methods.name: createIfNotExistsForUser
methods.description: Creates a destination calendar for a user if a conflicting one does not already exist.

methods.name: getByUserId
methods.description: Retrieves the first destination calendar record for a specific user ID.

methods.name: getByEventTypeId
methods.description: Retrieves the first destination calendar record for a specific event type ID.

methods.name: find
methods.description: Finds a destination calendar record based on specified conditions.

methods.name: findConflictingForUser
methods.description: Checks for conflicting calendar records for a user based on user ID, integration, and external ID.

methods.name: upsert
methods.description: Performs an upsert operation (update or insert) on a destination calendar record, with credential payload handling.
